text: Figure 12.50: PlatformModuleEthernetEndpointConfiguration for transmission of security events [TPS_MANI_03331] local ApApplicationEndpoint and NetworkEndpoint for transmission of security events Status: DRAFT ⌈The ApApplicationEndpoint (Udp or Tcp port number) and NetworkEndpoint over which the security event is transmitted on a VLAN is defined by the IdsPlat- formInstantiation.networkInterface reference. The referenced Platform- ModuleEthernetEndpointConfiguration defines: • the local NetworkEndpoint via PlatformModuleEthernetEndpointCon- figuration.communicationConnector.unicastNetworkEndpoint • the udp Port over which the security event is transmitted by PlatformMod- uleEthernetEndpointConfiguration.udpPort • the tcp Port over which the security event is transmitted by PlatformMod- uleEthernetEndpointConfiguration.tcpPort Please note that it is allowed to define either a udpPort or tcpPort or both.⌋
